mapper.select: SELECT p.proj_id AS "id",p.proj_nm AS "name",p.ctrt_type_cd AS "type",p.proj_stat_cd AS "status", p.ctrt_bgn_dt AS "startDate",p.ctrt_end_dt AS "endDate",p.ctrt_amt AS "amount", COALESCE(b.billed,0) AS "billed",p.opp_id AS "opportunityId" FROM tb_pj_proj p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT proj_id,sum(sply_amt) AS billed FROM tb_bl_bill WHERE cncl_yn='N' GROUP BY proj_id ) b ON b.proj_id=p.proj_id ORDER BY p.proj_id

SELECT opp_id AS "id",opp_nm AS "name",ctrt_type_cd AS "type",opp_stat_cd AS "status", bgn_plan_ym AS "startMonth",expct_prd_mcnt::int AS "months",expct_amt AS "amount", win_prbl_rt AS "probability",proj_id AS "projectId" FROM tb_sl_opp ORDER BY opp_id

SELECT n.opp_id AS "opportunityId",n.need_sn::int AS "needSn",n.job_cd AS "jobCode",n.bgn_ym AS "startMonth", n.prd_mcnt::int AS "months",n.need_cnt::int AS "count",n.mon_mm AS "monthlyMm" FROM tb_sl_opp_need n ORDER BY n.opp_id,n.need_sn
SELECT proj_id AS "projectId",job_cd AS "jobCode",plan_mm AS "mm" FROM tb_pj_mnpw_plan ORDER BY proj_id,job_cd
SELECT dev_id AS "id",job_cd AS "jobCode",use_yn AS "useYn",drct_cls_cd AS "directClass", jncmp_dt AS "joinDate",retire_dt AS "retireDate" FROM tb_hr_dev ORDER BY dev_id
SELECT dev_id AS "developerId",bgn_dt AS "startDate",end_dt AS "endDate" FROM tb_hr_dev_stat WHERE work_stat_cd='LEAVE' ORDER BY dev_id,bgn_dt
SELECT job_cd AS "jobCode",input_psbl_dt AS "availableDate" FROM tb_hr_cand WHERE cntc_stat_cd NOT IN ('HOLD','CTRT') ORDER BY cand_id
SELECT DISTINCT ON (std_cd) std_cd AS "code",std_val AS "value" FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY std_cd,aply_bgn_ym DESC
SELECT code AS "code",sort_ord::int AS "sortOrder" FROM tb_sy_code WHERE code_grp_id='JOB' ORDER BY sort_ord,code
SELECT asgn_id FROM tb_pj_asgn WHERE asgn_stat_cd='ACT' ORDER BY asgn_id
